title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Speaking Practice and Re-testing
prompt: Some education researchers argue that learners who practise speaking in small discussion groups make faster progress than those who mainly study alone, and that regular re-testing of speaking skills is the best way to confirm this progress. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? In your answer, discuss the benefits and drawbacks of group speaking practice and evaluate whether frequent re-testing is a reliable way to measure improvement. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你的总体立场（同意、不同意或部分同意），再分别讨论小组口语练习的优点与不足，并评价频繁复测是否能可靠反映进步。建议用两个主体段展开论证，每段给出理由与具体例子，避免只罗列观点。注意回应题目的两个部分，保持立场一致，结尾重申你的判断。
